name: laya-answer-router
description: Lets Claude answer the current Chrome page through local Laya without browser driving.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the loopback-only Laya relay. The Chrome side panel captures bounded DOM text, Laya chooses a fast or deep model, and Claude receives the answer without screenshots, clicks, typing, or submission.

relay_url.title: Local relay URL
relay_url.description: URL of the Laya relay running on this computer.

relay_token.title: Local relay token
relay_token.description: The same secret configured as LAYA_MCP_TOKEN in the local relay.

tools.name: laya_get_current_page
tools.description: Read the latest page captured by the Laya Chrome side panel.

tools.name: laya_answer_current_page
tools.description: Answer a question using the latest captured Chrome page.

tools.name: laya_answer_question
tools.description: Route and answer an explicitly supplied question.
